description: T4.1: Expand detekt/ktlint/jacoco to app-wide scope with baseline/ignoreFailures, add domain coverage gate at 40%
steps: Expand detekt source to all main+test source with baseline
Expand ktlint filter to all .kt with ignoreFailures=true
Create empty detekt baseline at config/detekt/baseline.xml
Add domain coverage includes, class dirs, source dirs, execution data, report and verification tasks
acceptance_criteria: detekt source covers src/main/java and src/test/java
detekt has baseline pointing to config/detekt/baseline.xml
Domain coverage verification task exists at 40% line coverage
findings: Expanded detekt to full src/main/java and src/test/java with baseline file. Ktlint set to ignoreFailures=true with comment explaining the burndown plan. Domain coverage gate added at 40% targeting RiskEngine, SmcDetector, MasterDecisionEngine, AgentOrchestrator, BacktestEngine, PositionCalculator, InstrumentTypeResolver. Both jacocoDomainCoverageReport and jacocoDomainCoverageVerification wired into testDebugUnitTest and check tasks. Brace balance verified (57/57).
